kicker: NONE OF THEM ARE ABOUT YOUR FACE
title: 8 things *attractive* men have in common

label: NUMBER 1
head: Clean nails, fresh breath, ironed shirt
sub: Hygiene is the cheapest upgrade you'll ever make.

label: NUMBER 2
head: One obsessive hobby
sub: Woodwork, climbing, chess. Talk about it and your eyes light up.

items.head: Good at one thing
items.sub: Cooking, fixing cars, a sport. Skill is magnetic.

items.head: Close to his family
items.sub: Calls his mom. Shows up for his brother.

label: NUMBER 5
head: Doesn't complain about what he won't change
sub: Hate your job? Apply elsewhere or drop it.

items.head: Kind to strangers
items.sub: Holds the door, tips well, helps carry bags.

items.head: Moves his body
items.sub: Lifts, runs or plays something weekly.

label: NUMBER 8
head: Not glued to his phone
sub: Phone face down at dinner. Full eye contact.

text: Every single one is a *choice,* not genetics.
